text:
## Complaint Categories & Handling  
### 1. Service Complaints  
**Example:** Long wait, incorrect information, rude staff  
**Investigation:**
- Check timeline
- Review procedures followed
- Assess reasonableness
- Interview staff if needed  
**Resolution:**
- If at fault: Apology + compensation for inconvenience
- Compensation: Up to £100 for minor inconvenience, more if significant distress/loss
- Learning: Process improvement to prevent recurrence

context: Investigation: Check timeline, Review procedures followed, Assess reasonableness, Interview staff if needed

raw_entities.name: Service Complaint Investigation Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to investigate service complaints through a structured process including timeline verification, procedure review, reasonableness assessment, and staff interviews where necessary.

raw_entities.name: Fault-Based Compensation Obligation
raw_entities.description: Obligation to provide apology and compensation when the bank is found at fault, with compensation levels scaled to the severity of inconvenience or distress caused to the customer.
context: If at fault: Apology + compensation for inconvenience
Compensation: Up to £100 for minor inconvenience, more if significant distress/loss

raw_entities.description: Requirement to implement process improvements and preventive measures following complaint resolution to prevent recurrence of identified service failures.
context: Learning: Process improvement to prevent recurrence

raw_entities.description: Operational risk category encompassing service delivery failures such as long wait times, provision of incorrect information, and poor staff conduct that may result in customer complaints and reputational damage.
context: Example: Long wait, incorrect information, rude staff

raw_entities.name: Complaint Resolution Authority
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for determining fault, authorizing compensation, and ensuring process improvements are implemented following complaint resolution.
context: If at fault: Apology + compensation for inconvenience
Compensation: Up to £100 for minor inconvenience, more if significant distress/loss
Learning: Process improvement to prevent recurrence

raw_entities.name: Complaint Timeline Review
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring verification and review of complaint timelines to establish the sequence of events and identify service failure points.

raw_entities.name: Procedure Compliance Audit
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring review of procedures followed during the service interaction to determine whether established protocols were correctly executed.

raw_entities.name: Staff Interview Process
raw_entities.description: Control measure enabling investigation teams to conduct interviews with staff members involved in the complaint incident to gather firsthand accounts and clarify procedural adherence.

properties.core_policy_statement: Bank shall investigate service complaints, determine fault, provide compensation where appropriate, and implement process improvements to prevent recurrence
properties.scope_summary: Applies to service complaints including long wait times, incorrect information, and staff conduct issues

properties.consequence_of_breach: Complaint may not be properly resolved; customer may escalate to regulator

applies_to: service complaints where bank is at fault

properties.consequence_of_breach: repeated complaints; failure to demonstrate learning
properties.required_action: implement process improvement to prevent recurrence

properties.risk_definition: Failure to deliver service to expected standard, including delays, inaccuracy, or poor staff conduct
properties.required_response: formal investigation, fault determination, compensation if warranted, process improvement

properties.accountability_for: thorough and impartial investigation of service complaints

specific_obligations: determine fault based on investigation findings
properties.authority: determine fault; authorize compensation up to £100 for minor inconvenience; approve additional compensation for significant distress or loss
properties.accountability_for: fair and timely complaint resolution; implementation of corrective actions

properties.evidence_required: timeline documentation showing when service was requested, delivered, and any delays
procedure documentation; records of steps followed; assessment of reasonableness
interview notes; staff statements; contemporaneous records
